data: 5-fold cross-validation on training IPs; test set not used
recommendation: Validation PR-AUC as the search objective. Fixed-threshold F1 was rejected: Ludwig would measure it at 0.5, while the project tunes the threshold afterwards, and class weights change what 0.5 means from trial to trial. PR-AUC needs no threshold and focuses on the rare class. ROC-AUC stays as a second recorded metric.
